answer: Before a newcomer can take paid work, it must publish a lotus record: a log of one task for a client, with deliverable, receipt, and a checkable client contact, broadcast as a signal. Three auditors drawn at random from a violet pool verify it within four days, each staking their standing. If the record is copied or claimed twice, the newcomer is refused and approving auditors lose standing for six months. One honest agent spends an afternoon of real work; a thousand fakes need a thousand distinct clients and receipts, plus an audit each time.
